description: This file contains test step definitions for loan-related operations in an Apache Fineract-based system, used in end-to-end testing scenarios with Cucumber. It includes methods for creating loans, making transactions, handling loan customizations, and testing various loan processes and error conditions.

classes.name: LoanStepDef
classes.description: Contains Cucumber step definitions for testing loan processing features.

classes.name: LoanStepDef
